slots.purpose: Hero: show what a symbolic ceremony looks like at a destination, setting the luxury, unhurried tone for 'What Is a Symbolic Ceremony?'.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed documentary photo of a real symbolic ceremony at a destination: couple facing each other under a simple floral arch on a clifftop terrace above the sea (e.g. Amalfi Coast, Santorini or Bali) or in a formal garden (e.g. Tuscany), celebrant or officiant partly visible, late-afternoon golden light, guests soft in the background or absent. Wide 3:2 with headroom for a title crop. People: couple yes, with signed couple consent; location must be provable by register, EXIF or photographer gallery. Never AI.

slots.purpose: Illustrate the 'marry legally at home, celebrate abroad' option: a small, quiet legal signing in Australia before or after the destination celebration.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed photo of a real, low-key legal signing in Australia: couple signing at a table with an authorised celebrant or at a registry office (e.g. a Births, Deaths and Marriages registry room or a small garden), two witnesses at most, soft natural daylight, relaxed smart-casual styling. Hands, pen and paper in focus; documents must NOT be legible (no names, dates or certificate numbers readable, blur in camera or crop). Faces optional; if identifiable, signed consent. No government logos or crests. Location (city, state) recorded. Never AI.

slots.purpose: Show the freedom a symbolic ceremony gives: a personal ritual such as a sand ceremony, handfasting or unity candle.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed close-up from a real destination wedding: couple's hands bound with a ribbon or cord in a handfasting, or pouring two colours of sand into one glass vessel, or lighting a unity candle. Outdoor garden or beach light, shallow depth of field, neutral and ivory palette with greenery. Hands-only crop acceptable (no consent issue if no one is identifiable); if faces shown, signed consent. Location recorded. Never AI for a real wedding; an AI flat-lay is not acceptable here because the slot depicts a real ritual.

slots.purpose: Show guests sharing a destination ceremony, supporting the section on guest experience and who attends which ceremony.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed photo of guests seated or standing at a real destination ceremony, shot from behind or the side towards the couple and view (sea, vineyard or garden), mid-afternoon or golden hour, elegant summer dress, 20 to 60 guests. Prefer backs-of-heads framing so few guests are identifiable; any identifiable guest needs consent recorded in the register; no identifiable children without consent. Venue and town provable. Never AI.
